name: Silver Pearl
summary: **Silver Pearl** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Sensi Seeds|Sensi Seeds]] in the Netherlands, a cross of [[early-skunk|Early Skunk]] and [[northern-lights-5|Northern Lights #5]]. Early Skunk itself traces to repeated crosses of [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]] and [[early-pearl|Early Pearl]]. The line is grown indoors and in greenhouses, finishing in 6 to 7 weeks.
